question: Identify the top 10 drivers with the shortest personal best lap times who also participated in at least one qualifying session where they recorded a Q2 time starting with '1:16'. Return their full names and nationalities.

WITH best_laps AS (
    SELECT
        "XCL_044" AS driver_id,
        MIN(
            CAST(SUBSTRING("XCL_047", 1, INSTR("XCL_047", ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
            CAST(SUBSTRING("XCL_047", INSTR("XCL_047", ':') + 1, INSTR("XCL_047", '.') - INSTR("XCL_047", ':') - 1) AS REAL) +
            CAST(SUBSTRING("XCL_047", INSTR("XCL_047", '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000
        ) AS best_lap_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
    WHERE "XCL_047" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY "XCL_044"
),
q2_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "XCL_058" AS driver_id
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE "XCL_063" LIKE '1:16%'
)
SELECT
    d."XCL_038" AS forename,
    d."XCL_039" AS surname,
    d."XCL_041" AS nationality
FROM drivers d
INNER JOIN best_laps bl ON d."XCL_034" = bl.driver_id
INNER JOIN q2_drivers qd ON d."XCL_034" = qd.driver_id
ORDER BY bl.best_lap_seconds ASC
LIMIT 10
